name: Create a centered image pattern on a two-tone split background
query: Create a full-width collection teaser pattern with a centered image, a vertical two-tone split background, and a widely tracked uppercase title below the image.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and confirm image asset, title text, text domain, metadata, and color presets
Step 2: Use a Cover or full-width Group with a hard-stop two-tone background
Step 3: Center a single image inside a constrained content area
Step 4: Add a short uppercase title below with intentional tracking and enough padding to avoid clipping
Step 5: Use decorative or descriptive alt text appropriately
Step 6: Escape and translate the title and image alt text
Step 7: Verify mobile fit, image loading, and editor parsing
success_criteria: Uses a split two-tone background and centered image composition
Title is short, uppercase, and intentionally spaced without overflowing
Image asset is local/approved and alt handling is correct
Uses block-native layout and no custom CSS classes
All strings are escaped and internationalized
No scripts, inline style tags, or query-time PHP
Verification includes mobile fit and image rendering
